# Isaiah Chapter 40 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 154v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_040_page_001.jpg

---

**40:1** Comfort [nachamu], comfort [nachamu] my-people [ammi], says your-God [eloheikhem].

**40:2** Speak [dabberu] to-the-heart [al-lev] of-Yerushalayim and-call [veqir'u] to-her, that her-warfare [tseva'ah] is-ended [male'ah], that her-iniquity [avonah] is-pardoned [nirtsah]; that she-has-received [laqechah] from-the-hand of-YHWH double [kiflayim] for-all her-sins [chattoteha].

**40:3** A-voice [qol] calling [qore]: "In-the-wilderness [ba-midbar] prepare [pannu] the-way [derekh] of-YHWH; make-straight [yashsheru] in-the-desert [ba-aravah] a-highway [mesillah] for-our-God [le-loheinu]."

**40:6** A-voice [qol] says, "Call [qera]!" And-I-said [ve'amar], "What shall-I-call [mah eqra]?" "All flesh [kol-ha-basar] [is] grass [chatsir], and-all its-loyalty [chasdo] like-the-flower [ke-tsits] of-the-field [ha-sadeh]."

**40:7** "The-grass [chatsir] withers [yavesh], the-flower [tsits] fades [navel], when the-breath [ruach] of-YHWH blows [nashvah] on-it. Surely [akhen] the-people [ha-am] [are] grass."

**40:8** "The-grass withers, the-flower fades, but-the-word [devar] of-our-God [eloheinu] stands [yaqum] forever [le-olam]."

**40:28** Have-you-not known [halo yadaata]? Have-you-not heard [halo shamata]? The-God of-eternity [elohei olam], YHWH, Creator [bore'] of-the-ends [qetsot] of-the-earth — he-does-not faint [lo yiaf] and-does-not grow-weary [velo yiga]; there-is-no searching [ein cheqer] of-his-understanding [li-tevunato].

**40:29** He-gives [noten] power [koach] to-the-faint [la-yaef], and-to-those-without-might [le-ein onim] he-increases [yarbeh] strength [otsmah].

**40:30** Youths [ne'arim] will-faint [yi'afu] and-grow-weary [veyig'u], and-young-men [bachurrim] will-surely stumble [kashol yikkashelu].

**40:31** But-those-who-wait [veqovei] for-YHWH will-renew [yachalifu] strength [koach]; they-will-mount-up [ya'alu] [with] wings [ever] like-eagles [ka-nesharim]; they-will-run [yarutsu] and-not grow-weary [velo yig'u]; they-will-walk [yelkhu] and-not faint [velo yi'afu].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Isaiah 40 — "Comfort My People" — formal English rendering preserving prophetic structure.

*— LOGOS*
